title: Tenma Saki — The Ever Cheerful One〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Class is over!
It's finally time for lunch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Haruka, do you wanna go have lunch at the rooftop since the weather is pretty good?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we usually eat at the courtyard so I'm fine with that for a change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't mind either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Then let's go now!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have arrived! It's my first time here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wah! Sorry!
I didn't think anyone would be here... Wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, aren't you Shiho's classmate, um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? You're alone today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, Haruka!
Yeah. The friend I usually ate lunch with had something to do today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's too bad!
Do you wanna have lunch with us then?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Can I really? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, I've finally achieved my dream of having lunch on the rooftop together with friends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Having lunch on the rooftop was your dream?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It really feels like I'm living my high school life to the fullest, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You may be right!
This does happen very often in manga and anime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You see, you see?
And I also made a new friend!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right! I forgot to introduce myself!
I'm Saki Tenma. Nice to meet you! And this is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello. My name is Ichika Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I'm Minori Hanasato!
It's so nice to meet you, too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You already know Kiritani, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course I do! The truth is...
Haruka's the reason I wanted to become an idol in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
Does that mean you've gone for auditions before?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Countless times, though I've never passed any so far...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I won't give up, so I practice dancing here every day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Every day?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! You're just like the main character in a manga or anime! You're really making the most out of your youth!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's the kind of life I wanted too.
To throw myself into something, like club activities and such...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why you joined the soft tennis club, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, Ichi and I were invited to form a band together, so we're both doing our best with that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're in a band?! That's so cool!
Which instrument do you play?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi's on the guitar and vocals.
I'm the keyboardist!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm gonna go shop for my own keyboard with Ichi real soon♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow... You're really serious about this!
And that's super cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's like they're old friends already.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Hanasato's a really nice girl, isn't she?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She is. That's probably why they hit it off right away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori, you have my support for your idol dream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's both do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's nice to chat, but you should really eat something too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gasp! I was having so much fun I forgot about that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come on, Saki, you should eat too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for reminding me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Food always tastes better when you eat together with others!
